If you are day trading today, then perhaps today it can be interesting and I will outline how I would position myself to play this, If not day trading, then simply just sit out. Less is more and volatility will drain you emotionally. 

1. The market is weak, and has been weak for at least 2 weeks since my "leaders w/ after-party desserts" comment. Time has passed, market should start to come out of food coma. All the ingredients for a real turn is there, but no evidence yet. Breadth is still in free fall. Oil/war still lingering around, so even after rates decision, oil and midterm still play a role. 

2. We have seen #1 size darkpool printed in ITB, XAR, BUG, IHI (homebuilding, defense, cybersecurity, medical device etfs) etc near the low yesterday. AKA big participants have likely entered the position, and started the accumulation phase. yday I said institutions sold upside calls, bought atm puts and also crash OTM puts. The data checked out. 

3. My choice of product to trade for day trading is tqqq, For swings, I have eyes on softwares and some AI names (DELL, AMD, BE, INTC). No intention to trade them today, again happy to watch how they perform. 

4. Day trading: My only trade is to short around SPX 7635-40/QQQ710 Monday high, or higher 7660-70/QQQ 717, **if** after-rate decision vol crush takes us there.  My bias today is we still have some downside to go.
